card.name: Digits inside fraction counts
card.fires_on: The last digit of a two-digit denominator or numerator in patient counts like (37/42) or 20/42 episodes, in adverse-reaction summaries. It also fires weakly partway through a few drug names such as carbamazepine.

modes.label: Digits in patient counts
modes.description: A digit within a two-digit number in an n/N fraction of patients or episodes.
modes.example: Systemic corticosteroids were required in 88% (37/4<<2>>) of patients with hypophysitis.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a drug name, after a syllable such as am or hydro.

card.plain: It marks the digits of patient counts like 37/42 in side-effect summaries, and sometimes the middle of a drug name.
